column1: # Allow-listed identity collisions (plan section 5.2 step 3, D106; curated in the repo).
# Each row is a group of different recipes, in one map, whose identity hashes start with the
# same 12 hex digits: they share a citation key r:<map>/<sig12>. A group listed here is
# accepted as genuine. content12 holds the first 12 hex digits of each recipe's content hash,
# comma-separated: the first recipe gets the key r:<map>/<sig12>-1, the second -2, and so on.
# A new row lists them in content-hash order (plan section 5.2); after that the order never
# changes, so a citation keeps its recipe. If one recipe of a group is rebalanced (a new
# content hash, the others as listed), it keeps the suffix that is left and the build report
# asks for its new content12 here. A group that isn't listed, has another size, or has two or
# more recipes no content12 matches fails `gos db build`, which writes a curation task with
# Check each new group in NEI before adding it, and say why it is genuine.
# The rows below came from the dev-runtime harness run of 2026-11-06 (GT 5.09.54.265 and its
# dependencies); the first full-pack run will show which still apply (stale ones are reported).
